purpose: Distinguish failure to learn realized-label utility from architecture or optimizer failure using an exactly input-determined positive control.
trigger: After all27 utility runs and the already queued risk stage; do not add a GPU job ahead of risk.
teacher: Centered negative log of cached original frozen router teacher probabilities; depends only on x and contains no realized next-token label.
protocol: Same x and train/internal-dev split, rank8, normalization, initial parameters, minibatches and4000steps as utility prediction. Select best dev MSE. Original cached gate probabilities are an input-determined teacher; compare calibration, not language quality.
interpretation: If deterministic teacher is learned but realized-label utility is not, this supports a target/available-information bottleneck in this protocol. It does not establish an irreducible Bayes noise floor. Preserve architectures that fail positive calibration as limitations.
